meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把指定的 NanoClaw 智能体组切换到本机 Ollama 模型运行:修改容器配置与模型设置、重启服务,并验证本地模型已接管请求。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体在本地运行、节省 API 费用,或想尝试开源权重模型而提出切换时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude will redirect a specified NanoClaw agent group from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model: it edits the container config and model settings, restarts the service, and verifies Ollama is handling the traffic.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to run an agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models; it kicks in when a switch to a specific Ollama model is requested.

say_en.text: Switch mygroup agent group to the local Ollama model.
say_en.note: It will ask which model you want first.

say_en.text: Have the agent run locally, not via the Anthropic API.
say_en.note: It will block api.anthropic.com if you agree.

say_en.text: Use qwen3-coder for this agent group on local Ollama.
say_en.note: It restarts, then verifies Ollama takes traffic.
